consumer: The frontend tile renderer asking 'what threat color does the GUI paint this monster?' — mirroring the engine's own monster-attitude/threat-tint coloring routine.
scope: The per-monster displayed threat color the GUI would render (the engine's attitude/danger-to-color mapping for that visible monster), not its raw vitals.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) — emits raw hp/hp_max/moves/hallucination integers straight from engine getters, never the engine's threat-color verdict.
divergence: A monster the engine tints by attitude/danger rather than absolute hp: a full-hp friendly/neutral creature and a full-hp hostile one share identical hp/hp_max/moves yet the GUI paints them different threat colors — the raw-vitals surface reports them identically and the frontend cannot reproduce the tint.
